testCases.name: Route Definitions & Precedence Conflict
testCases.description: Catch-all wildcard route declared before static and dynamic routes shadowing all downstream paths.

findings.message: Catch-all route '*' declared before specific '/users/:id' and '/' routes will shadow and prevent downstream route matching.

testCases.name: Unencoded Dynamic Param in Target URL
testCases.description: Navigation target path constructed with unencoded string interpolation.

findings.message: Dynamic parameter 'docPath' interpolated directly into URL path without encodeURIComponent.

testCases.name: Missing Route Param in Lifecycle Effect
testCases.description: Component fails to observe route param updates, causing stale data when navigating between products.

findings.message: Component data fetch effect relies on 'productId' but passes empty dependency array [].

testCases.name: Query Parameters Wiped During Navigation
testCases.description: Updating pagination parameter completely overwrites existing search params object.

findings.message: Setting search params with { page } without preserving existing search filters.

testCases.name: History Stack Spam on Live Keystrokes
testCases.description: Live search input triggers history.push on every keystroke breaking back button navigation.

findings.message: Live input change invokes push navigation instead of replace navigation.

testCases.name: Direct URL / Deep Link Crash via Location State
testCases.description: Component directly reads location.state without fallback, throwing runtime error on page refresh.

findings.message: Direct access of 'location.state.order' without null checking or URL-based entity recovery fetch.

testCases.name: Auth Guard Premature Child Route Render
testCases.description: Protected route guard renders Outlet while session loading is pending.

findings.message: Auth guard renders Outlet when auth.isLoading is true, leaking protected views before authentication resolves.

testCases.name: Missing Outlet in Parent Layout
testCases.description: Parent layout configuration registers child routes but omits Outlet in layout JSX.

findings.message: Layout component omits '<Outlet />', preventing nested child routes from rendering.

testCases.name: Uncancelled Fetch on Route Change Race Condition
testCases.description: Route data fetch effect lacks AbortController or active flag, allowing stale responses to overwrite newer data.

findings.message: Route param data fetch lacks cancellation/abort mechanism, risking out-of-order race conditions.

testCases.name: Missing 404 Catch-All Route Fallback
testCases.description: Router lacks a catch-all wildcard route, causing blank screens on unknown paths.

findings.message: Router configuration missing catch-all '*' 404 route fallback.

testCases.name: Clean Frontend Routing Implementation
testCases.description: Exemplary implementation featuring proper route precedence, parameter encoding, abortable loaders, outlets, and history replace.
